statements.t: There were no material operational activities in the three months ended September 30, 2026 and the Company does not expect future activity or losses from discontinued operations.
The Company does not currently expect material future operating activity or losses associated with the discontinued operations.
The Company expects continued runoff of total residential mortgage loans.

Subsequent to September 30, 2026, management obtained additional information regarding the borrower’s expected payment performance and, based on its evaluation of the facts and circumstances existing at September 30, 2026, classified the loan as substandard as of that date.

Since the appraisal, management has become aware of a new material lease agreement that the Company anticipates will increase the net cash flows of the real estate collateral and may increase its value.

dropped.t: The Company expects to absorb remaining assets and liabilities, at fair value, into the Bank's statements of financial condition in the third quarter of 2026.
The Company expects remaining losses from discontinued operations to be significantly less over the final months of 2026.
The Company expects approximately $749 thousand in annual savings going forward within continuing operations due to these reorganization changes.
